title: E-QTM-0121: the fear share of a two-role whole is (1 - e^(-mana)) / 2, so its ceiling is set by the most magic pure...
purpose: Experiment E-QTM-0121 in the quantum arena: the fear share of a two-role whole is (1 - e^(-mana)) / 2, so its ceiling is set by the most magic pure state of two qutrits: a deterministic search over sign patterns bounds that state's Wigner norm, which sets the predicted ceiling against the 1/3 of Cauchy-Schwarz, and every fear share the knit reaches is checked against it.
known_limitations: Depth L1 (L1: known mathematics, correctly confirmed).
